{{Top|leg}}
A '''Vertical''' was a standard [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Vertical fences required the [[swoopchaser]] to jump their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] over the barrier. The counterpart to the Vertical was the [[Shift-Vertical]]. The [[Repulsor-In]] and [[Repulsor-Out]] Fences were Verticals.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
